fields.unit: Shared with the inter-agency security channel
fields.distribution: Security focal points of NGOs and UN agencies in Karun Province
fields.summary: Two NGO vehicles were held for several hours at an unofficial checkpoint near Bel Ravi on 15 October. Both were released without injury. Reports of further informal checkpoints on Route 4 and Route 9 have not been confirmed.
recommended: Review movements on Route 4 north of Bel Ravi.
Report further checkpoint sightings to the shared channel.
Brief drivers on the reporting steps.
fields.handling: Share with security focal points only. Do not forward outside the inter-agency security channel.
